01 — About

I create visuals that stop the scroll — without expensive software or a design degree.

I'm a self-taught graphic designer from Kerala. I learned design the honest way — making things, getting feedback, improving. Every poster and creative in my portfolio was built on a mobile device using Canva, PicsArt, and PixelLab.

Where I go further than most is with AI tools. I don't just generate and download — I write detailed, structured prompts that control composition, mood, and style. The result is AI-assisted work that looks like intentional design, not a lucky accident.

I'm open to freelance projects, remote design work, and design-adjacent roles. I work best when given creative trust and a clear brief.
